description: Phenotype frequency profile of TANC2-related IDDALDS from HPO annotations
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rows = [
 ("Intellectual disability","HP:0001249",19,20,"Nervous"),
 ("Delayed speech and language development","HP:0000750",18,20,"Nervous"),
 ("Autistic behavior","HP:0000729",15,20,"Nervous"),
 ("Motor delay","HP:0001270",13,19,"Nervous"),
 ("Motor stereotypy","HP:0000733",13,19,"Nervous"),
 ("Chronic constipation","HP:0012450",9,15,"Digestive"),
 ("Seizure","HP:0001250",11,20,"Nervous"),
 ("Spastic ataxia","HP:0002497",5,13,"Nervous"),
 ("Sleep disturbance","HP:0002360",5,13,"Nervous"),
 ("Generalized hypotonia","HP:0001290",5,13,"Musculature"),
 ("Anxiety","HP:0000739",4,12,"Nervous"),
 ("ADHD","HP:0007018",4,14,"Nervous"),
 ("Joint hypermobility","HP:0001382",3,9,"Other"),
 ("Craniosynostosis","HP:0001363",3,14,"Head/neck"),
 ("Developmental regression","HP:0002376",2,11,"Nervous"),
 ("Microcephaly","HP:0000252",3,18,"Head/neck"),
]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["phenotype","hpo","k","n","system"])
df["freq"]=df.k/df.n
# Wilson 95% CI
from scipy.stats import beta
def ci(k,n):
    lo = beta.ppf(0.025,k,n-k+1) if k>0 else 0.0
    hi = beta.ppf(0.975,k+1,n-k) if k<n else 1.0
    return lo,hi
df[["lo","hi"]]=df.apply(lambda r: pd.Series(ci(r.k,r.n)), axis=1)
df=df.sort_values("freq")
print(df[["phenotype","hpo","k","n","freq","lo","hi"]].to_string(index=False))

colors={"Nervous":"#4C72B0","Digestive":"#DD8452","Musculature":"#55A868","Head/neck":"#C44E52","Other":"#8172B3"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,7.5))
y=np.arange(len(df))
ax.barh(y, df.freq*100, color=[colors[s] for s in df.system], alpha=.85)
ax.errorbar(df.freq*100, y, xerr=[ (df.freq-df.lo)*100, (df.hi-df.freq)*100 ], fmt="none", ecolor="0.3", capsize=3, lw=1)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{p}\n({h})" for p,h in zip(df.phenotype,df.hpo)], fontsize=8.5)
for i,(f,k,n) in enumerate(zip(df.freq,df.k,df.n)): ax.text(min(f*100+ (df.hi.iloc[i]-f)*100 +2, 99), i, f"{k}/{n}", va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("Frequency among reported patients (%), with exact 95% CI")
ax.set_xlim(0,112)
ax.set_title("TANC2-related IDDALDS (MONDO:0030051 / OMIM 618906)\nHPO-annotated phenotype frequencies", fontsize=12)
handles=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=c) for c in colors.values()]
ax.legend(handles, colors.keys(), title="Organ system", fontsize=8, loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
